name: Fetch Rayvn files
info:
Fetches all transferable files for a single Rayvn entry.
Mirrors Fetch Wasos files — same contract, same structure.

### Input
- msg.payload — entry object after Classify files
- msg.metadata.files.items — synthetic file objects with .url (signed URL)

### Logic
1. Prepare download list — backs up entry, splits into per-file messages
2. Get Rayvn file — plain HTTP GET to signed URL, resolves type/name from headers
3. Compress? — routes oversized files through Compress Files
4. Store file via global context — stores buffer, builds context_key
5. Join — reassembles results
6. Merge files and rebuild entry — separates successes from failures

### Output
- msg.payload — rebuilt entry
- msg.metadata — updated .files.items (stored) and .files.failed
